title: C¹ approximation of a Lipschitz function along one C¹ chart on compact Borel pieces (Simon Ch. 3, proof of 2.4; Ch. 2, Theorem 1.5)
statement: Let P, N ∈ ℕ, let M ⊆ ℝ^P be Borel, f : ℝ^P → ℝ L-Lipschitz (L ≥ 0), ψ : ℝ^N → ℝ^P a C¹ map and V ⊆ ℝ^N open (ℝ^k = Euclid k). Then there are Borel sets Y_k ⊆ ℝ^N and C¹ functions F_k : ℝ^N → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) such that for every k: closure(Y_k) is compact and contained in V, ψ(Y_k) ⊆ M, and f(ψ(y)) = F_k(y) for all y ∈ Y_k; moreover H^N((M ∩ ψ(V)) ∖ ⋃_k ψ(Y_k)) = 0, where H^N = μHE[N].
lean_statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal) (ψ : Euclid N → Euclid P) (V : Set (Euclid N)), MeasurableSet M → LipschitzWith L f → IsOpen V → ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → ∃ (Y : ℕ → Set (Euclid N)) (F : ℕ → Euclid N → ℝ), (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (F k) ∧ MeasurableSet (Y k) ∧ IsCompact (closure (Y k)) ∧ closure (Y k) ⊆ V ∧ ψ '' Y k ⊆ M ∧ ∀ y ∈ Y k, f (ψ y) = F k y) ∧ μHE[N] ((M ∩ ψ '' V) \ ⋃ k, ψ '' Y k) = 0
